"Such a question, Polaris… is an invincible matter that always, without fail, drives the one who asks it to corner the one who hears." he said.
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main6_Content_2: "Whether I am a being of fiction; and if I am, what precisely that means; what my meaning is… such a question, once it bites in, is like a needle driven past the nose and lodged in the skull, impossible to pull out. Line up all those who, sunk in some like worry, fidget and fret — they would be as many, surely, as the stars I commanded in my prime." As he clenched and spread his fist, the remnants of his former world that had followed Yubar — galactic crystals and shards of starlight — flowed slowly across his palm. "And yet, at the same time, those sunk in such worry will, sooner or later, arrive at a like conclusion —" The remnants of the world ranged themselves in orderly file and formed a shape. A crude replica of the very night sky he was now beholding — no, a pattern of constellations that described it still more beautifully, a score, a painting, a passage of prose, a sculpture. It was a scene that ached with longing and at once stirred up hope for what was to come. "— that whether outside the story or in, I am, by my own choosing, where I ought to be. And there, I am making the choices that are mine to make." Yubar gazed for a while at the night sky of the Rapids he had recomposed with his own aesthetic, then waved it away. The first, but by no means the last, imagining of a true night faded so beyond the reach of memory. The flickering galaxies and crystals of star returned obediently into their master's palm. "At the least, I believe that is the answer. That whether inside my world or out, I am where I ought to be, bound to no one's hand, doing the work that is mine to do." The festival honoring the nearest star, the homeland of the master craftsmen, the countless secrets recorded in seven spires… in Yubar's two eyes, settling calmly, a shooting star formed. "And I wish to see that reality for myself." he said in a resolute voice. "Not the reality after your scheme is all accomplished — all disordered and scattered, unsettled, laid to waste. The pure place as it is, here and now, I wish to plunge into myself, as I am here and now, and experience to my heart's content." The most logical and reasonable plea to follow on from that, Yubar idly conjured up. So will you not wait just a little? Hold off your plan. Only until I have gone and seen reality…. But what was it he had so emphasized about gods and godliness, about the nature of a god? "So the shameless posture of asking you to wait will not do…." said Yubar with a small laugh. "For one who is, once — no, still — a god to attempt such a thing on another striving to become a god, and to expect that the god who hears it will be meekly talked round and bend her own resolve — that will not do. It would be a wretched deed!" Starlight scattered between Yubar's fists. Black graphite became a transparent cubic crystal, then, unable to withstand the heat and pressure, vanished at last into the empty air. "Greenhorn you may be, you are striving to become a god. You have set your mind upon a work only a god can do, and you are not, for it, stretching out your hand to me here and now. Once you have tied off your other, more urgent matters, it is rather you who will not spare me a glance." He went on. "And so, the next time we meet, we will be two gods in earnest — clashing over purposes that no longer align." Laughter burst out of him all at once. Yubar was struck by the sudden impression that Polaris, all that day, had likely been thinking much the same thing. One is the one striving to become a god, the other the one who wishes still to believe himself a god… both alike lacking and wanting in much the same way, so that, near enough, one might 'lump' the two of them together as gods, each in his own fashion. "So next time, please, let us not exchange greetings… or did I do it first." Yubar yawned. From observing the products of dreams and the Travelers come from reality, all told, he could now mimic such gestures, at a fitting moment, with nothing out of place. He raised one hand proudly to the corner of his eye, and found that, in place of tears, a small shooting-star's tail had formed. It was a point that still wanted attention. "How should two figures who each bear a different purpose and paint a different future of it — two gods who dream different dreams — carry on some dragging negotiation, trading nothing but pen and ink back and forth?" The word figure naturally called to mind the theme of story, and the story outside the story. A story, however, is at once the backdrop of its figures and the sum total of the experiences and convictions woven from those figures' own choices. "So when next we meet, please, let us bring out the tale of two gods and face each other without reserve." Yubar smiled and closed his eyes. The imagining of the night sky unfurled larger and more splendid still, taking the darkness behind his eyelids for its canvas. It was a new cosmos, to be made by the creative power he would reclaim once he reached the end of the Rapids. "You and I have each heard our fill of the other's preamble; now it is time to bring out, in earnest, the main body — and after that, without fail, the very ending — and pit ourselves against each other!" At the same time it was both bridgehead and starting line. It was the seed of a story in which Yubar, become a god once more, would at last set out in search of the new secrets of reality. "As for who was truly telling the more meaningful story — that, surely, someone outside the story of us two gods shall judge!"
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main6_Short: Two would-be gods circle the same impossible question: how do you know you can save a world before you've tried? And which of them is still being deceived?
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main6_Title: From a God, to a God
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main7_Content_0:
At that moment Yubar felt some workings and turned his head. Not by the ordinary sensory means through which one comes to know another is present — sound, say, or heat, or light — but by workings. The manifestation of such an abstract power was an exceedingly rare thing in the Rapids, and to Yubar, who had once composed the symphony of the cosmos in fellowship with stars and galaxies, it was a feeling at once newly strange and welcome.
In the place he looked with shining eyes, there was Yubar.
Yubar came walking out, parting the thickets before Yubar.
Those watching gaped in astonishment. They were, at bottom, followers of Yubar. Some were dream-born beings, but there were Travelers who had drifted in from reality as well. Regardless of origin or conviction, they had at some turning point witnessed Yubar's mighty power, and as a result had become, just so, his believers. Yet across all the various doctrines and taboos they had only begun to fashion, there was not a single word on what Yubar should do upon meeting another Yubar — nor, before that, on whether such a thing was even possible. The believers trembled in terror. Eyes wide as saucers, they wavered, marking time in place, until they tripped over their own feet and steadied themselves by gripping their own stumbling arms.
The two Yubars, meanwhile, merely gazed quietly at each other. They drew near without once breaking their gaze. What passed between them was not words but a fierce exchange of looks and portents, intimations, momentum. The galactic crystals and clusters of star that each circled, around the bodies of the two Yubars, clinked and collided. They clamored as if to measure their lengths against one another. The intensity and period of that light grew fiercer by the moment. Left alone any longer, it seemed it would turn into the outright explosion of something. Then all that taut tension melted away like snow. The two Yubars nodded to each other and each went his own way. They parted without a backward glance.
The ones left dumbfounded were the watching followers.

"Of course we spoke with each other."
Later, when questioned by the followers, Yubar — either of the two will do well enough — spoke thus.
"Why did we simply pass each other by, you ask? I clearly said… ah."
Yubar's evasive expression vanished then as if washed away.
"I failed to consider. That here, to convey anything, one must make a sound,"
meaning that the two Yubars had conversed not in words but as abstraction. For some while Yubar pondered how to translate it into something his followers could understand.
"We spoke and parted thus… 'So — you, too, have a star of your very own.'"
It was a pregnant sentence, but it did little to aid his followers' grasp of reality.
"But what does that precisely mean?"
"Is there some other symbol to it? He had his star, and I had mine — that is all."
said Yubar.
"Amid the countless galaxies and countless stars each of us dreams, each already had a star he cherished; so each could tend the star he wished, in the way he wished, and press on toward the future he envisioned. There was nothing to quarrel over."
"And yet, surely two Yubars cannot both be Yubar in just that way?"
the followers implored.
"Should you not contest who will be the true Yubar — who will, at last, be worthy of the name of Yubar?"
"How could the eternal and boundless story of a god appear in this Rapids through but one moment, but one single face?"
Two lines that meet may meet at one point alone; but the points that dwell upon a single line where two planes meet are beyond all counting. Did his followers lack even this simple piece of common sense?
"You mistake the many forms that the eternal story which is Yubar takes as it meets the boundless world which is the Rapids — the back of my hand and the sole of my foot, my shoulder and my neck — for separate 'Yubars,' and so you imagine they would fall into conflict with one another. That is all."
The faces of the listening followers turned pale. For they had read the wrath that lay within Yubar's voice.
"We beg you, put us to death!"
Yubar gazed with satisfaction upon the followers pleading and groveling. In his former world too, it had been like this… or had it? And more to the point, since when had he gone about the Rapids trailing a string of followers behind him?
Yubar opened his eyes.
When, without thinking, he ran both hands over his whole body, the abruptly severed memories began, little by little, to return. He wondered why, all the while, he had believed it was otherwise even as he lay with his back to the ground and his eyes shut — and what he had believed himself to know or feel amid all those facts that were no facts at all. At last a word that could explain all that strangeness surfaced in his mind.

"…Is this, then, a 'dream'?"
He looked down at his two palms in bewilderment, as though the answer might be written there.
"It has been no time at all since I began to mimic the sleep of others, and already I can sink into dreaming as well!"
Yubar raised himself up. Wondering what one ought to do in such a case, he flung both arms above his head and stretched, putting strength all at once into his chest, his waist, his thighs.
"Very good indeed!"
It was a textbook stretch.
"If I go on learning like this, one thing at a time, then becoming a god who holds every secret of this world in his grasp is surely only a matter of time."
At that moment Yubar felt some workings and turned his head. Not by the ordinary sensory means through which one comes to know another is present — sound, say, or heat, or light — but by workings. The manifestation of such an abstract power was an exceedingly rare thing in the Rapids, and to Yubar, who had once composed the symphony of the cosmos in fellowship with stars and galaxies, it was a feeling at once newly strange and welcome.
In the place he looked with shining eyes….
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main7_Short: He meets himself across the thickets and finds nothing to fight over — only a quiet truth. So you, too, have a star of your very own?
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main8_Content_0:
"You mean to say you do not know us?"
"Oh, but I do."
There was someone small, gazing up at the towering, armored figures. Battered by their trials in the Rapids, the golden suits of armor were faded and cracked here and there — yet the radiance pouring from all of them at once was dazzling.
"Are you not the ones who gave me this 'sweet thing'!"
He spread open the bundle he had been handed, beaming.
"That is higher praise of you than any name I know."
The great strapping men who heard this were bewildered. Through armor that covered them head to toe without a gap, they glanced at one another, then back at this someone with whom they had not yet so much as exchanged names. They had never met the like. Above all, it was the first time some little creature, like the one before them now, had looked upon them without flinching.
The order these knights belonged to, and the Order that was its parent body, were the most influential institution on the entire continent. Even the haughtiest royal house, even the guilds of merchants or artisans, could not take a single step without the Order's seal — such was the way of things. Naturally, anyone who came face to face with them would bow their head the instant they saw them, or recite some clumsily half-learned prayer, sparing no effort to win their favor.
And yet — where in the world had this one crawled up from?
The knights looked. They scrutinized, inch by inch, the appearance of this stranger they had met in the Rapids. Short of stature, and slight of frame. A beast-person whose whole body was covered in sleek fur, but with no apparent gift for using that body. The voice seemed to belong to a child who knew nothing of the passing years, or to some brash young woman.

"Perhaps she is a girl who is not quite right in the head."
One of the knights whispered to his companions.
"If so, then she is one we are bound to protect. The light of the sun does not forsake the sick…"
"I am no woman."
"Do you truly not know who we are?"
The words crossed past one another. The knights, not realizing they could be overheard murmuring among themselves, were thrown into no small confusion.
"There are reasons I bear this form — but never again address me by such a title."
The "young woman" part aside, the "not quite right in the head" part did seem to fit after all. The knights fell silent a moment, then returned to their original line of talk.
"In any case — you do not know who we are, is that it?"
"And do you, for your part, know me?"
"The nerve of this one, to keep on so!"
A knight with an especially low flash point bristled and stepped forward.
"We are none other than the Solar Flame Knights."
"Oho?"
The little beast-person cocking his head was not in the least the reaction he had hoped for. And the sight of him, all the while, rummaging through the handed-over bundle with one hand to fish out its contents, made his blood boil all the more.
"The most favored fighting force of the Order of the Sacred Flame, and the keenest blade that honors the will of the sun."
"Ah! In that case —"
The stranger snapped his fingers. And then he dared to babble out words beyond all imagining.
"— you are the ones who pin a god's name to the nearest star and dote upon it, lifting it on high?"
This was not a matter of astronomical knowledge. It was a matter of the order of the world. The sun could not be the same as a star. The sun could not dare be compared to, ranked beside, or set on equal footing with anything in all the world. It was no wonder the knight who heard those words reacted on reflex. He seized the stranger's limply dangling wrist hard enough to shatter it.

"What did you just say?"
He bore down with enough force to splinter even an axe-haft of sturdy wood wound round with rawhide, yet the stranger's expression did not so much as flicker. Seeing this, it was the knights who shuddered instead.
"Choose your words with care. How could the grace of Lord El'pyros be likened to the little lights of the night sky…"
"Has it never struck you as strange?"
Chewing with relish on the field ration he had at last put in his mouth, the stranger went on.
"Why the difference between the sun and the stars came to be drawn in just that way… Has it never occurred to you that perhaps there is no fundamental difference there at all — that somewhere very near those stars of the night sky, each of those stars might itself be a 'sun'?"
The knight gripping the stranger's wrist worked his fingers. It felt like clutching an ingot of metal and straining for all he was worth. When he drew his hand away, something seemed to ripple for an instant along the stranger's skin. Shards of light? He could not tell.
"No ordinary creature, this."
The one who led the knights cleared his throat and spoke.
"For now, we shall detain you until we rejoin the captain —"
"My thanks for the sweets!"
The stranger sprang lightly to his feet, brushing himself off. Clutching the bundle of field rations in one hand, he began, without the slightest concern, to walk away.

"Where do you think you are going?"
"Wherever it is I must go."
The knights glared at him with fierce eyes, but none stepped forward readily. For what the knight who had held his wrist had glimpsed — a shield and armor of brilliant, radiant starlight, a mace, a blade — was once again rippling supplely into being around him.
"Do you not realize that we have just rescued you from this place?"
"It is yourselves you have saved."
The stranger, who had turned and begun to move off, stopped in his tracks. He had noticed that someone was gripping the front of his garment in a less than friendly manner.
"Wait."
A knight, the cold light of his eyes gleaming beyond his visor, spoke.
"No one gave you leave to come and go as you please."
The stranger sighed. A hand clutching his sleeve was easily shaken off — but seeing the other knights, emboldened by their comrade's act, move one by one to block his way, it seemed this could not end well no matter how he wished it. Men who had merely managed to survive this long, never dying, by hiding behind thin sheets of metal and swinging other thin sheets of metal honed to an edge, by that paltry trick alone. The fruits of an ignorance that, from the lowest stratum of the world, had never once wondered at the rules, the order, the truth of anything higher. The stranger closed his eyes as though sick to death of it. And he said:
"This you have brought upon yourselves."
Yubar opened his eyes.
{IMAGE}
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Main8_Short: Mistaken for something small and helpless, he asks the armored faithful one heresy they cannot forgive: what if your sun is merely the nearest star? And who, truly, has just been saved?
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Short0_Content: For the first time, Yubar tasted what a kind resident of the Rapids called ice cream. Back when he was a god, Yubar would create star confections to eat, yet those were mere imitations of sensation—true taste was a realm that dwelt beyond his world. For one who has lived through eons in pursuit of truth, this very moment is yet another discovery: that just as much as the providence of the cosmos, this trifling sensation melting upon the tip of his tongue holds a truth all its own. It was a knowing that could be gained only through experience—one he could never have possessed as a god.
ui.TravelerStory_Yubar_Short1_Content: Amid the remains of the Monster, Yubar gazed down at the wound gaping open on his forearm. The flowing blood soon turned to a pale, ashen powder, crumbling and scattering to the wind. That which was once eternal is no more. Before this truth, for the first time, he came face to face with a strange emotion he had never known before—fear.

C_BeamOfLight.memory:
-- Experiment Log, Year 3, Day 20 of Month 1
-- Author: Carrier Bayonet
-- Research Subject: Beam of Light


Subject: Young widow. Severe burns from face to shoulders. Infected wound on cheekbone.
Result: Cheekbone infection visibly reduced. Burns appear slightly faded.

Subject: Boy. Open wounds on back from whipping.
Result: Back wounds healing well. Boy claims his "thieving habit" is now "cured" and demands to be released.

Subject: Jeff (the infamous murderer). Gunshot wounds to both ankles and wrists.
Result: Complained of intense head pain, then a small "pop" sound was heard before he passed out.
Note: Still breathing but remains unconscious.


P.S. His Majesty King Rojit has provided 10 additional death row inmates. Much research remains on this beam, but one thing is certain: this power of dreams will save many lives.

C_MagicSword.memory:
In the quiet dawn,
when I visit the back garden of Highgate Manor,
a memory rises, unbidden.

The cool air of the old training hall, still brushing against my cheek.
My childhood self, casting only the smallest of shadows.
Mother's voice, sharp as frost.

The Teal Blade.
The family sword—strength and pride of House Verdesilver.
Like a steadfast tree, straight and unwavering,
Mother showed me the blade that day.

But my sword could not follow her teachings.
The tip trembled like a leaf dancing in the wind, and my strength flowed away like water.

Isn't it ironic, Mother?
The proud tree you fought so hard to protect has fallen and broken,
while this worthless leaf, scattered by the wind,
is the one that survived.

Now the family's pride is gone, the weight of the tree lifted...
but I have no regrets.

All I wish for now is...
to wield this blade as a nameless mist that has lost its teal,
for the happiness of my younger sibling.

C_MassProtection.memory:
Every time the Moonlight Council convenes, we extend this great barrier. It is a solemn act, signifying that the Society exists solely in the pursuit of truth, under the profound and absolute belief that we must not interfere in any affairs of the outside world.

Lately, however, I have felt a strange dissonance and a cold realization within this absolute silence. This perfect peace so thoroughly erases the cries of countless lives fading away outside, and our "neutrality" is merely a noble privilege gained at the cost of remaining silent before their suffering.

For some reason, I am reminded of that child's face. Aurena. I realize that the logic we used to block her "dangerous" inquiries bears an uncanny resemblance to the logic we now use with this barrier, shutting out the "dangerous" chaos of the world.

Are we truly "protecting" the truth? Or are we merely "protecting" ourselves from everything we have given up trying to understand?

I wonder if this sacred protection ultimately serves not our sublime neutrality, but our deepest cowardice. I still do not know the answer.

C_Whirlwind.memory:
Excerpt from the Chronicles of the Forgotten Snowy Mountain:

In the days before the great mountain was broken, giant children played a game called "Chasing the Blizzard." Each child would carry a small wooden axe, mimicking their ruler, Skoll. His wild, spinning destruction appeared to them as a hero's dance and a song of glory.

The children would spin around until they collapsed from dizziness, dreaming that one day they too might protect the mountain as the great storm itself.

No one knew.

The hero's dance they so admired would become the very storm that shattered their world. The song of glory they sang would turn into the mountain's dirge.

E_AntiGravity.memory:
Our master, Lord Erebos, simply wished to please Lady Nyx.

When he lightly stomped his foot in the starry forest, steadfast mountain ranges would rise and float like pebbles, suspended by a thread. With a single gesture of his hand, the earth would split apart and rise again, creating new landscapes. Our master would laugh like a child at these magnificent sights. Thet power that shook the heavens was nothing more than a dazzling proof of love meant for one alone.

Yet was I the only one who saw the cold shadow cross Lady Nyx's face in those moments?

What shone in her eyes was not joy, but awe and... a fierce spark of jealousy she could not conceal.


- Memory trace of a nameless night spirit.

E_Blink.memory:
Hunting Journal
Year o of Rojit's Rule, Day oo of Month o, Weather: Cloudy
Hunting Location: Hising Forest
Today's Harvest: A few wild strawberries


Whenever I see something burning, it pulls me back to that day.
The sight of my wife, suddenly engulfed in flames and gone.

It happened in an instant. She turned to ash, consumed by a blue flame so bright it made my eyes sting.

I checked all my ammo and powder pouches, but nothing was missing.
Something was off. A fire that burns that fast without smoke, without even being hot... it's not natural.

Then today, while watching some archers through my scope, I discovered something very interesting.

That there are bastards out there who can wield blue flames.

...

First things first, I need more information.

I have to be careful if I want to get my wife back. For now, I have to swallow this boiling rage.

However, I've stumbled upon something even more significant. I've uncovered an insight into the fundamental power of dreams, but I'm running out of space in this log. For now, I'll refer to this as "Dismantling Force" and continue my research.

E_ClutchesOfMalice.memory:
How many days have I been lost in this twisted dream world?
As my sense of time dulled, something began to take shape before my eyes.
Beyond the mist, "I" was standing there.

At first I was merely curious, but the moment I met its gaze, I realized what writhed in those depths was not my soul, but something strange and damp. It was fear itself.
As it slowly reached toward me, its back split open and blood-red tentacles burst forth. At their ends hung not just pieces of flesh, but living eyeballs, staring intently at me like seeds planted to spread this nightmare across the world.
Only then did I understand. That was not my reflection in a mirror. It was a hungry clutch of nightmares, using me as a host and seeking to consume this world.


- Memory trace engraved in someone's fragment

E_FinalExplosion.memory:
The encirclement of the Order of the Sacred Flame tightened without a single gap.
Their holy flames denied even the deepest alley its darkness.
Cornered at a dead end, the Lucid Sect member finally stopped.

But instead of fear, a strange, ecstatic smile crossed his face.
He looked down at the knights closing in on him as if they were pitiful insects.

"You think... this is the end? Do you truly believe you can judge me with that false god's arrogant little flame?"

He closed his eyes and focused all his senses.
Beyond the clamor of reality, he heard it—the gentle whisper of the dream world,
the Rapids he had longed for.

Now, it was time to abandon everything and depart.
He opened his eyes once more to bid a final farewell to reality.

"Farewell! You blind flames... this worthless flesh... and this wretched world!"

His body began to flicker violently, taking on an otherworldly hue.
A prayer—the most fervent and desperate offering to his god.

"Lord Primus! This lowly servant offers... everything I am... to you now!"

His final cry reduced his very existence to a handful of dust,
becoming a magnificent final explosion that consumed everything.


— Memory trace from a corpse in a ruined village

E_FlameJet.memory:
Hunting Journal
2nd Year of Rojit's Rule, Day xx of Month x, Weather: Clear
Hunting Location: Igni Wetlands
Today's Harvest: A pocketful of nettles

There are rules I always follow when I go hunting in the Igni Wetlands.

1. Be cautious if you spot claw marks on mangrove roots.

2. If those marks aren't covered in moss, steer clear of that direction.

3. If you see smoke in the distance or smoldering embers on charred trees, head home immediately.

I made these rules after what I saw through my scope last summer. Some fool tugged on a half-scorched Kalimberry vine and came face to face with a monstrous Barasus.

I don't think I've seen flames that big, not even at the Royal Guard's fire weapon demonstrations.

E_UmbralEdge.memory:
After hearing rumors about Shangri-La, I returned to the Puppeteer's workshop.

The abandoned corpses remained, and the ruins carried their familiar stench. My memory tells me this is where the tragedy that took everything from me began. Yet my body and mind showed no reaction, just as I expected.

I wasn't here for sentimentality. I had another purpose. Amidst the ruins, I found traces of a memory, seemingly hidden by the Puppeteer.

It was the memory of a swordsman I did not know, carrying a foreign blade, not of eastern origin. He was not simply cutting; he had captured the abyss within his sword and wielded the void itself.

A strange sense of kinship came over me. I understood that sword. It was a kind of emptiness that only those with hollow souls could inhabit.

Screams froze in the air, and the bone-piercing cold stripped me of all feeling.

That wolf's howl was not of a victor. It was the wail of one who had lost everything, the desperate scream of a shattered kingdom.
And we died beneath that crushing despair, nothing more than dust, choking on our helplessness.
This blizzard is not mere cold.
It carries his despair mixed with my curse, his sorrow swirling with my rage.

This is a living hell.


- Memory trace of a mercenary buried in the Snowy Mountain, moments before death.

L_MentalCorruption.memory:
As I wander through this world, I sometimes meet people who are aware of the dream world. A rare few remember our encounters completely, allowing us to keep connecting again and again.

One day, while speaking with one of them as usual, I noticed the light suddenly fade from their eyes. That empty gaze was fixed on me.

"Is she truly happy here?"

Suddenly, he called out to me with a question.

"Or is she merely a beautiful doll trapped in your perfect cage?"

In that moment, my world shook. A wave of fear froze my heart. As if my anxiety were contagious, everyone around us began to warp, their hidden hatred and fear for each other rising to the surface.

With my power, I erased the source of that corruption, leaving not a single trace behind. Like an illusion, the chaos vanished, and the world slipped back into its false tranquility. But I saw it. In the shadows, something unseen was mocking my deepest self.

No. This utopia is mine. My wife... my family must be real. I cannot lose them again.

I will make sure this never happens again. No cracks, no doubts.

Never again, will I allow it.

U_Hysteria.memory:
The nightmare's corruption was not a sudden event. It seeped in slowly, like poison, through the deep wounds he received while protecting the forest.

First, his horns twisted into demonic shapes, even though they once marked him as a forest guardian. Then came his nails. From hands that once nurtured life, black claws grew, ready to tear everything apart. The warmth and mischievous playfulness in his eyes disappeared, replaced by the red light of a starving beast. It was as if his original purpose was being both denied and mocked.

As his reason faded and pure pain and fury took hold of his body, he let out one final, broken breath.

"Nachia... I'm sorry..."

But those words reached no one, fading away at the very moment the last spark of the being called "Belphomet" was extinguished.

This was both his last cry and the first howl of the nightmare that took over his body.

U_WorldCracker.memory:
A memory trace of one who was once among the most powerful beings in the world of dreams. It is a fragment of power from one who was king and god of all spirits.

Wielding the authority of divine radiance, he could reduce entire worlds to ashes with a single blow. He challenged the master of worlds but was defeated, and afterward, his whereabouts became unknown. Rumor holds he was imprisoned in another dimension, lost most of his power, and was left as nothing more than an ordinary king.

Yet the whispers told a different story.
They spoke of the symbol of his servitude having disappeared.

C_Shatter.memory:
As a collector of stories, I simply gather tales. My role and my destiny are to follow a predetermined path from beginning to end. Just as Sisyphus in the old legend came to love his boulder, I have accepted my fate as well.

But you have always been different. You refuse to let your story follow the path set out for you. Whenever I hear you say, "Just because we were born this way does not mean we must live only that way," I feel a small crack forming in my storybook.

Do not misunderstand. This crack is not unpleasant. In fact, it fascinates me. Among the countless stories racing toward their fixed endings, yours is the only one whose next page I cannot predict.

I am eager to see what ending your stubborn defiance will bring. That final chapter may become the most treasured piece in my entire collection.

E_Blossom.name: Essence of Blossoming
E_Blossom.memory:
Early dawn, and the rain is falling.
It reminds me of that day, when we bloomed flowers together.

I wanted to create a pure white flower, like the quiet dawn.
A child like a lantern, holding all the forest's order and tranquility.

But you, crouched beside me watching, suddenly grumbled.
Then you carelessly scattered deep purple like a storm, and playfully painted over it with lightning-yellow.

I scolded you, and you only laughed.
I truly believed my perfect plan had been ruined by your chaos.

But the next morning, when we looked at that flower together...
Over the pure white serenity, your riotous colors flowed like a living river.

Only then did I understand.
Yes, the forest's true beauty requires both my order and your chaos, intertwined.
Only then does it become complete.

...
The rain... seeps into my mask.
Today, more than ever, I wish I could see
your mischievous eyes again.

E_Crimson.memory:
I opened my eyes. The trance had ended.
Every joint in my body creaks and groans, yet I feel no pain.

Fragments of memory drift across my hazy consciousness.
The Puppeteer. The client. And the failed contract...
These faint pieces come together at... my master's familiar estate.

Red. Everything is red.
What's this at my feet? Ah, it was a person.

Crimson.

Did I create this? This sea of red?
Indeed, a mountain of corpses in an ocean of blood...

But why?
Why does my heart remain still, without a single ripple?

E_Direness.memory:
How am I still alive...?

...

I was definitely locked up in the Order's prison.
...Those Lucid bastards had set a trap.
That was my mistake.
I was too hasty.

It's strange.
My breastplate was shattered, and I was sure at least two of my ribs were broken...
But I feel fine. No, I actually feel stronger.

Where am I? Is this some kind of magic...?

...
It's faint, but I can sense it.
Astrid, my sister...
I won't let myself slip up again.

Just wait for me. I'm coming.

The same lovely shade as the roses Mrs. Maria next door used to grow,

Urged on by the girl, the book hurriedly wrote the next story using that paint as ink.

E_Overload.name: Essence of Overload
E_Overload.memory:
Every time I reflect on this concept, I feel my body and mind being engulfed in flames.

The scales on the affected areas crumble easily, radiating an intense heat. When I gather the golden dust from certain parts, it shines brilliantly and feels incredibly fine to the touch.

Magic unfolds through the power of dreams, and when this dust is added, the reaction becomes even more explosive. Just a light sprinkle left a large scorch mark on the ceiling.

I should document the results of this experiment, but I'm too drained. This concept seems to inflict a heavy mental toll.

I suspect it's connected to the power I encountered before. It's fascinating, indeed. More research is needed to uncover the source of this power. Perhaps a field study is needed.

Do not blaspheme. I am not a lunatic who revels in inflicting pain. Yet, I cannot overlook those who defy divine authority.

For the one who watches over us from above,

I will, rightfully and with honor, sear your skin and carve your flesh.

Hungry... always.
My nest is a mountain of bones.
Flesh... prey... not enough.

But... something new. Came.
Smell of flesh. Smell of fear.

Crush bones. Tear flesh. Swallow screams.
This is my work. This is... Lord Primus's pleasure.

You too... become bones.
Part of my nest.
Lord Primus's... beautiful landscape.

Kik, kikikik.

People are dying. Monsters and spirits that once existed only in legends and imagination have crossed into our world, burning villages and destroying lives.

Of all times, it had to be when Lady Camilla and my sister are away...

We can hold out for now, but what if the rumors are true? What if someone's imagination has really become reality?
And what if someone imagined something even more terrible than what we're facing now...?

It's only a matter of time.
Are we supposed to sit here and wait for this inevitable disaster?

...

Yesterday, I managed to infuse my sister's saber and my dagger with the power of dreams.
Now I just need information.

I know someone who can help me.
The Lucid Sect... unsettling as they are, they're probably my best option.

L_Perfect.memory:
Others once worshipped me as a god.
Yes, there was a time I truly believed I was omnipotent here.

I was reunited with the family I missed so dearly,
and everything I had imagined or dreamed came so easily.

It was perfect...
No, I only believed it was perfect.

A dream, in the end, is still just a dream.
My omnipotence was, in truth, no different from helplessness.

Reality is not a realm of inevitability.
This place... is nothing but an illusion.

L_PureWhite.memory:
People who have experienced "Molting" all describe their dreamscapes in unique ways.

Some witnessed endless tables piled with meat on silverware, others encountered long-lost relatives, and some found themselves in gardens filled with mood-lifting teas and fragrant roses.

Yet no one has ever truly eaten their fill of that dream food or brought their missing loved ones back to reality.

Our bodies stay firmly in the waking world. Dreams are just brief visits our minds make to the other side. We always wake with empty hands.

That's when the Lucid Sect stumbled onto something incredible.

We can now enter dreams ourselves—in the flesh.

R_Adventure.name: Essence of Adventure
R_Adventure.memory:
To the girl, adventure is the thrilling act of filling blank pages.
With each step she takes, a new sentence is written, a new character appears.

Today, too, the girl shared her bright smile with a sad-looking mother bear.
The bear then shattered into pieces,
becoming a swarm of shimmering blue butterflies that thanked the girl.

Every day, the girl spends such rewarding moments.

R_Contempt.memory:
Day 4 in The Rapids.

I finally have a moment to catch my breath and write again. My whole body still aches, and my hands won't stop shaking, but I have to get this down.

A few days ago, with help from the Lucid Sect, I managed to enter this world called The Rapids. To my surprise, the forest was full of mystery and wonder—sunlight danced between the leaves, and I felt for a brief moment as if I'd stepped into a fairytale.

But it didn't take long to realize that this peacefulness was only a fragile illusion. By afternoon, the fog began to settle, and beyond it, we caught sight of something watching us from the mist.

Even now, my hands tremble as I remember. There was a towering, grotesque creature with smoldering red eyes, its jaw twitching in an unnatural rhythm. In the blink of an eye, it was right in front of us.

Everything after that is a blur. I remember running for my life, my lungs about to burst, the screams of my companions, and the awful sound of flesh being torn apart.


I think I'm safe, for now, but I'll never forget the contempt in its eyes as it tore people apart with those long, cruel claws.

- A.

R_Flow.memory:
What a strange and unfamiliar truth this is. What you have shown me is undeniable, the unmistakable touch of fate. Once, I governed the birth and death of stars, their majestic resonance echoing within me completely. Now, everything drifts out of reach, as distant as shadows in the mist.

Yet my will remains clear, bright as the morning star. I will draw the path of my own destiny, and I will break these chains.

Until my final breath, I will remain the one who leads the dance of creation and oblivion. For I am the true god of stars.

R_Rejuvenation.name: Essence of Rejuvenation
R_Rejuvenation.memory:
Somewhere in a secret place within the Rapids,
a location also known as the Land Between,
the air was filled with the clinking of backpacks.

"Senior! Just by approaching that statue, my creaky joints smooth out and my pack feels lighter! Even my worn shell seems to regain its luster! Why do I feel so rejuvenated?"

The one called senior slowly blinked their multiple eyes
and let out a sigh—
a clear sign of exasperation at the question.

"Because He shares a bit of His yesterday
for our today."

"His... yesterday? Then every time we gain strength, does our Guide... does He molt like us? Or does His shell crack?"

The senior slammed their sturdy claw on the table with a sharp 'THWACK!'

"Ugh, tsk! Does this Jonas have a starfish for brains?! Instead of worrying about nonsense, tighten your pack straps! The power He gave you isn't for polishing your carapace!"


- From the Regular Jonas Gathering

R_Wound.memory:
The wound... won't heal.
Beyond the throbbing pain, it devours me
like a living curse.

The eerie violet eyes filling this cavern,
and the floor's patterns glowing as if writhing...
Like an endless scream, they seem to burrow
into my flesh trapped behind these bars.

And among countless eyes, one shines brightest.
He inflicted this wound upon me, then did nothing.
He merely observes and records my wound,
my suffering, with detached interest.

Yet that indifferent gaze terrifies me
more than any wound ever could...

tips.AllyEffectOff: You can adjust the intensity of ally skill effects in the settings.
tips.Armor:
Armor reduces the damage taken.
For example, a Traveler with 100 Armor takes 50% less damage.
tips.AvoidAttacks: Evading attacks is more important than attacking.
tips.Cold: The Cold effect reduces the Attack Speed and Movement Speed of enemies.
tips.DamageAmp: When you have multiple effects increasing damage and healing, they all apply multiplicatively.
tips.Dark: Enemies corrupted by Dark take 5% increased Dark damage per stack.
tips.EssenceSynergy:
Essences equipped in the same Memory can trigger and interact with one another.
Experiment to create powerful synergy effects.
tips.Fire:
Memories that deal Fire damage have a chance to apply stacks of Fire to the target.
The Fire effect deals damage over time, with damage increasing as more stacks are applied.
tips.FireNoProc: Fire damage over time can't trigger Essences or other effects.
tips.HealPotion: Defeating monsters has a chance to drop a Health Potion. This chance increases the lower your health is.
tips.Hero_Aurena0: Aurena's favorite food is eel rice bowl.
tips.Hero_Aurena1: Before her dismissal, Aurena had a habit of recruiting exceptional students as research assistants and unwitting experimental subjects.
tips.Hero_Aurena2: Aurena considers most people, with very few exceptions, to be no more than talking snails.
tips.Hero_Aurena3: Despite being expelled from the Society, Aurena still wears the silver brooch symbolizing a Lunar Sage.
tips.Hero_Aurena4: What Aurena despises most is the conservative ethics committee of the Lunar Arcanum Society.
tips.Hero_Aurena5: Aurena became the youngest Lunar Sage in history, but she herself doesn't consider this fact particularly significant.
tips.Hero_Bismuth0: Bismuth perceives all reality as a fairy tale through her books, and acts like a character from those stories.
tips.Hero_Bismuth1: Bismuth's kindness sometimes leads to cruel outcomes. Like filling a hungry wolf's stomach with stones.
tips.Hero_Bismuth2: Sometimes the girl and the book inside Bismuth converse with each other. To others, of course, she just appears to be a strange child talking to herself.
tips.Hero_Bismuth3: Once, Bismuth helped a lonely scarecrow by nailing several live birds to its shoulders to give it friends.
tips.Hero_Bismuth4: Bismuth occasionally detaches pieces of the metallic crystals that have become part of her body to give as gifts or trade for food.
tips.Hero_Bismuth5: When Bismuth drinks warm milk with honey, she looks like nothing more than an ordinary child.
tips.Hero_Cetus0: Cetus, worried that his fearsome appearance might intimidate others, actually has a surprisingly bashful side and grows timid in front of strangers.
tips.Hero_Cetus1: Cetus has a gentle, altruistic nature at heart, but the moment he witnesses the weak being oppressed, his gaze turns cold in an instant.
tips.Hero_Cetus2: Cetus loves gazing at the wide-open horizon of the night sea, which reminds him of the hometown he can barely remember from his childhood.
tips.Hero_Cetus3: To this day, Cetus's favorite dish remains the seaweed soup that soothed his hunger back in his orphaned childhood.
tips.Hero_Cetus4: Cetus's body mutated through the cult's experiments, and as a result, he now requires far more food and sleep than others.
tips.Hero_Cetus5: In villages Cetus has passed through, whenever it snows, the children build an 'Ice General' in his likeness.
tips.Hero_Husk0: Due to habits from his assassin days, Shell unconsciously touches the hilt of his knife at his waist from time to time.
tips.Hero_Husk1: One of Shell's daily routines is meticulously polishing his masks engraved with various emotions.
tips.Hero_Husk2: Shell deeply dislikes the faint sounds his joints make when he moves, as they remind him that he is no longer human.
tips.Hero_Husk3: Though Shell can no longer remember the taste of his favorite grilled fish, that single memory sometimes causes him to stare endlessly at fish in rivers.
tips.Hero_Husk4: Shell instinctively avoids situations where he might see his reflection, going out of his way to avoid even puddles of rainwater.
tips.Hero_Husk5: Shell considers others' jokes and metaphors to be inefficient forms of speech, unable to understand their emotional context.
tips.Hero_Lacerta0: During his time in the Royal Guard, Lacerta often enjoyed betting beers with his subordinates on shooting contests.
tips.Hero_Lacerta1: Lacerta feels strangely insulted whenever he sees a lizard.
tips.Hero_Lacerta2: Lacerta has a habit of fidgeting with a glass vial containing traces of Iris whenever he rests.
tips.Hero_Lacerta3: In villages around the Hissing Forest, Lacerta is known by the nickname 'Shadow Hunter'.
tips.Hero_Lacerta4: Lacerta still can't bring himself to throw away the art books that Iris cherished, keeping them in his cabin.
tips.Hero_Lacerta5: Lacerta still treasures the shooting journal from his days in the Royal Guard.
tips.Hero_Mist0: Most of the money Mist earns from duels goes toward buying materials for her sister Astrid's blacksmithing work.
tips.Hero_Mist1: Mist often observes the elegant movements of cats and applies them to her swordsmanship.
tips.Hero_Mist2: Tea time with her guardian Camilla Highgate is the only moment when Mist truly relaxes.
tips.Hero_Mist3: Mist finds attending lavish noble parties more difficult than life-or-death duels.
tips.Hero_Mist4: As a child, after grueling training sessions, Mist's greatest pleasure was eating nuts drizzled with sweet honey.
tips.Hero_Mist5: Though typically taciturn, Mist speaks to her sister Astrid with the gentlest voice in the world.
tips.Hero_Nachia0: To Nachia, a single dewdrop on a morning glory at dawn is a finer meal than any feast in the world.
tips.Hero_Nachia1: The Dreamlike Forest that Nachia once protected has now become the Forest of Turbulence, filled with unsettling energy.
tips.Hero_Nachia2: Nachia is benevolent, but her goodness is closer to the order of nature itself, making it difficult to compare with ordinary human morality.
tips.Hero_Nachia3: In the past, Nachia would carve fallen old trees into shapes of spirits or animals and place them throughout the forest.
tips.Hero_Nachia4: Nachia sometimes absently hums an old song she used to sing with her younger brother, before falling into silence.
tips.Hero_Nachia5: Nachia's younger brother still lives in the forest they once shared. Now as a demon who no longer recognizes her.
tips.Hero_Vesper0: When resting, Vesper has the peculiar habit of crushing stones to powder in his hand.
tips.Hero_Vesper1: Vesper firmly believes that his armor, bestowed by the Sun God El'pyros, is the most perfect work of art in this world.
tips.Hero_Vesper2: The conclusion of all Vesper's missions is personally conducting a purification ritual against heretics.
tips.Hero_Vesper3: Vesper surprisingly shows a gentle side when dealing with children.
tips.Hero_Vesper4: Vesper considers failing a mission to be a sin equivalent to betraying the gods.
tips.Hero_Vesper5: Thanks to training even more severe than the torture practiced by the Order, Vesper can endure most pain without flinching.
tips.Hero_Yubar0: Yubar longs for the taste of star cookies he used to enjoy in his former universe.
tips.Hero_Yubar1: Yubar has a habit of mixing poetic expressions into ordinary conversations.
tips.Hero_Yubar2: Rather than despairing over the fact that he was a fictional being, Yubar found himself more intrigued by the new possibilities.
tips.Hero_Yubar3: The particles of light that follow Yubar are small fragments of the Milky Way he once commanded.
tips.Hero_Yubar4: Yubar considers tasting food an artistic pursuit of exploring new cosmic truths.
tips.Hero_Yubar5: Yubar holds complex feelings toward the guide who revealed to him that he was merely a character from a fairy tale.
tips.Light: Enemies exposed to Light take 5% increased Light damage per stack.
tips.ProcCoefficient:
Memory hit effects are influenced by the hit coefficient of each Memory.
For example, single-target Memories trigger hit effects more powerfully than those dealing area of effect damage over time.
tips.SkillHaste:
Memory Haste reduces the cooldown of all Memories.
For example, with a Memory Haste of 100, cooldowns will be reduced 100% faster.
tips.Startdust: Collect Stardust to purchase souvenirs from special merchants, or buy stars after your journey ends to strengthen your Traveler.
tips.Survival0:
Surviving in the Rapids Chapter 1: 'Move Unpredictably'
You must keep moving irregularly to prevent enemies from landing their attacks.
tips.Survival1:
Surviving in the Rapids Chapter 2: 'Always Avoid Monsters Shrouded in Black Mist'
Directly confronting a Hunter is suicide.

I am so...
very...
hungry.
...Thank you.
...I possess the ability to read the stories of dreams.
It was inherited from the Master of Dreams... for I am the projection, and the creation, of his beloved.
...I never wished for it, but thanks to it, many more places were open to me.
With this ability, I could go wherever I wished across the countless worlds of The Rapids,
and it became my means of passing even to and from the real world.
...And so, without my ability — without my guidance —
you may wander these worlds for an eternity before you reach the place you seek.
But I no longer have the strength to guide you...
Now that your journey's destination has grown uncertain,
the path to your wish,
and even the path to Primus, will be far beyond your reach.
...Traveler, I only ever wanted one thing.
That all the others like me, born of someone's imagination,
would not linger as mere illusions, waiting to fade away,
but live on as whole, complete beings of their own.
So please, let me ask you one last time.
Truly... will you not change your mind?
Change your mind. Accept the offer
Refuse the offer.
...Wait, please wait.
One last time... let us speak, Traveler.
Where... where did it all go wrong...?
That form just now, that power... what was it...?
It was not... my ability...
This cannot... be happening...
What is happening... Maré...
...I am... hungry.
No... no. Now is not the time...
Jonas... I cannot let your sacrifice be in vain...
...I see. Very well...
An uncertain future and a merciless journey await you.
But... I pray that you find not only the Shape of Dreams, but your own meaning, Traveler.
You...
Traveler, this is... not a good time. So please, let us keep this brief.
...My memories are growing dim. There is not much time left...
I cannot be certain how much I have already told you. So let me say it once more.
Most beings of this world cannot survive without the power of reality.
Most of them do not even know why they are vanishing. They simply grow fainter with each passing day.
And Primus above all — he seeks to sever the Pure White Dream completely from The Rapids and from reality.
All for a reality of his own — one that can never be shattered.
...So long as he means to bar the gates of the dream, the power of reality, and everyone's wishes with it, will drift further and further away.
My plan remains the same: to tear down the boundary between dream and reality.
...But I am no longer in a position to wait patiently, as I once did.
And you — you have even found your way to my dwelling.
So please, answer me now... will you join me in my plan?
Accept the offer.
Refuse the offer.
...What a relief. It is not too late — not yet.
The light of my guidance shall shine upon the road ahead of you.
So face Primus, enter the Pure White Dream, and achieve what you desire.
Leave the rest to me.
That curse...?
I can guess how you made it all the way here... But allow me to cleanse it.
...For that is something that happens regardless of my will.
...You bear no curse. And yet you still reached this place.
I cannot say whether I should be relieved... or disappointed.
I see...
I am sorry. Truly — I no longer have the luxury of simply letting you go.
There is no ill will.
...Go. Find your own path.
...Haha, very well.
Go. I hope that you... will find your path.
Would you allow me to read the story of that artifact?
Give artifact to Dream Teller
Decline
This place is beautiful today, as always.
I wonder who first dreamed this place up?
Even when artifacts lose their shine, their stories never lose their value.
Tales of war, loss, and sorrow... they leave my heart heavy for a while.
But that doesn't make them any less valuable than other stories.
Ah, what a truly beautiful story.
The sea of stories is so vast and radiant. Have you ever been there?
If you find artifacts you'd like me to examine, just bring them to me.
Human "songs" are really fascinating.
They use melody to express love, talk about despair, and stir up all kinds of emotions.
When I focus on a song, I can feel what the person felt while creating it, what they poured into those notes.
I'd like to make my own song someday.
Isn't it amazing?
Even after thousands of years, these stories inside artifacts are still alive.
Reading a story is like traveling back in time.
Each artifact has its own voice.
If you listen carefully, you can hear the story they want to tell.
I can help you hear them.
When I talk with artifacts, I completely lose track of time.
On nights with strong moonlight, their voices get clearer.
Lord Primus once told me I was a strange child.
Because I talk to objects... but I'm happy this way.
Listening to their stories is my purpose, my reason for being here.
I understand. I'll save my story for another time.
I understand. I'll tell you my story next time.
I understand. I'll keep my story for later.
Hello there. I'm the [Dream Teller], drawn to you by the power of that artifact you have.
That artifact you're holding, even though it's lost its power and looks useless now... it's still someone's treasure.
If you give me the artifact, I'll tell you the story inside it. Would you hand it over?
Give artifact to Dream Teller
Decline
Hello there. You have something mysterious with you.
Ah, you've brought an artifact.
Good to see you. What story did you bring today?
What a beautiful artifact... I wonder what secrets it has.
Ah, you've brought another piece of history.
I can hear a faint whisper from that artifact... Want to listen?
You've brought another treasure today.
That seems quite precious to you.
If you change your mind... just let me know.
That's too bad. Let me know if you change your mind...
I understand. You can't force connections with artifacts.
Come back when you're ready.
You still want to keep that story?
That's okay... Your feelings matter too.
I see... Maybe your story with this artifact isn't finished yet?
Come back whenever you're ready.
Hmm... looks like this artifact still wants to stay with you.
If you change your mind, just come find me.
If you have time... want to hear my story?
Listen to the story
Let's hear it next time
Thank you so much. I'm excited to see what story this artifact has...
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
Oh, thank you. I'll tell you the story inside this artifact.
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
What a special artifact. Thank you. I'm sure it has an interesting story...
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
I wonder what secrets this artifact is hiding...
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
Ah, I can already hear this artifact's voice. Want to listen together?
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
This is a special artifact... I'm happy we can share its story.
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
A story is waking up... it's glowing softly like moonlight... Can you hear it?
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
Can you smell the old dreams? This artifact has a really special story...
`%artifact:artifactShortStory`
I'm the storyteller of this world. Collecting stories is why I'm here... It makes me happy.
Did you know everything in dreams has its own story?
Just like I have my story. But... you're different somehow.
I know almost every story from the dream world, but yours... I can't figure it out at all.
Were you born recently?
I'd like to collect your story someday too.
I was made by Lord Primus' wish... He's the Master of Dreams.
I was created less than 100 years after he set foot in dreams.
He was confused and curious about dreams.
His mind wanted something to explain dreams, and that's how I was born.
But that happened without him really meaning to, and I have my own thoughts too.
Maybe that's why? I feel like collecting stories is my only purpose, separate from Lord Primus.
It reminds me of Sisyphus from human stories.
Do we become like the stories we love?
What stories do you like?

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Sometimes, the power of dreams you've acquired becomes unnecessary.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: When Memories and Essences no longer serve you, dismantle them into Dream Dust.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Dream Dust contains the fragmented power of dreams.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Use this Dream Dust to empower your remaining Memories and Essences.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Essences of the same kind naturally merge, growing more powerful in concept.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: The power of dreams you've claimed remains yours to shape as you wish.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: [Concept Remnant] crystallize imagined ideas into [Essences] through the power of dreams.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Use the conceptual power within these Essences to transform your Memories.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Now, infuse your newly acquired Memory with conceptual power.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: These shards hold the intense experiences of those who came before us. We call them [Memories].

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Memories shaped by the power of dreams are yours to command.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Accept the Memories from the past.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I know you entered The Rapids with your own purpose.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: But whatever it may be, you will not fulfill it.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Master of Dreams and creator of these Hunters you faced.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: The first dreamer.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: He now forces the inhabitants of The Rapids into submission, slaughtering those who resist.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: He seeks, I believe, to claim the pure power of dreams for himself alone.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: ...If you wish to survive, if you hope to fulfill your purpose,

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Gain strength and confront him.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I will be watching.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Those are Hunters. These shadow-tainted creatures have appeared recently, preying on all outsiders they find.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Be wary of encountering them as you journey through The Rapids.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I fear our time grows short.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Greetings, Traveler. I am [Polaris], a child of dreams. The beings here know me as the [Guide].

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: You have already faced death once. The Rapids is a realm of many such dangers.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Learn to survive here, or your existence will surely fade away.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Fortunately, we are surrounded by things that may aid you.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Come with me.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: You will only survive The Rapids by mastering Memories and Essences.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I lend you more of my Essences.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: The power of dreams manifests differently depending on the form of each [Remnant].

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Now, extract the power of dreams from this [Concept Remnant].

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Those who walked The Rapids before you sometimes leave behind [Remnants] filled with the power of dreams.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Extract the power of dreams from this [Memory Remnant].

lines.speaker: Mock
lines.text: Within The Rapids, dimensional rifts serve as pathways.

lines.speaker: Mock
lines.text: Ride the rift to where my voice guides you.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: That's quite enough.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: What do you think you're doing?

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I see your attachment to that Memory, but it serves no purpose.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Drop it and dismantle it.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: This serves no purpose.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Cover your mouth, at least.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Sneezing will not help you in battle.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Drop that sneezing Memory and dismantle it.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: ...Something is wrong.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Something approaches.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: By combining these concepts, you can create far more powerful Memories.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Test out the empowered Memory on these apparitions.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Now test your empowered Memory on this apparition.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Use your Memory's power against these apparitions.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: You learn swiftly.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I give you one of my [Essence of Charcoal].

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Use these two Essences to transform the Memory you've acquired.

lines.speaker: Mock
lines.text: You're awake.

lines.speaker: Mock
lines.text: My power of guidance has preserved you for now, but... you remain in danger.

lines.speaker: Mock
lines.text: Follow my voice.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: What is happening...?

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Be careful!

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: In your current state, you cannot survive for long.

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: I hold your thread of life with the power of dreams, but...

lines.speaker: Polaris
lines.text: Your existence requires pure dream power to become complete.
The moment your fingertips touch the lingering traces, forgotten memories quietly flow in...
Out of stock. Jonas has just protected your wallet.
A tiny Polaris statue that shines especially bright, since the Jonases polish it even more devotedly than their own shells.
An essential item to pack more carefully than even your backpack straps. Forget it, and a senior's pincer comes flying your way.
Holding it close gives you the powerful illusion that you're about to meet a sucker... er, a wonderful customer.
The rift is so tiny that it looks like only a hermit crab could squeeze through.
[Jonas Code of Conduct 1]
We are all 'Jonas, the Memory Bearer.'
Never forget the weight of that name.
[Jonas Code of Conduct 2]
Your backpack straps are your lifeline.
Always tighten them up.
[Jonas Code of Conduct 3]
The power of the Sanctuary is for the weak.
It's not there for you to polish your own shell.
[Jonas Code of Conduct 4]
Treasure your gold.
Don't forget. Everyone's tomorrow depends on it.
[Jonas Code of Conduct 5]
Always give thanks to Polaris.
When the journey becomes too much to bear, look up and gaze at the North Star.
[A note scrawled on a faded, tattered scrap of parchment]
Oh, great Polaris!
Thanks to your radiant light, my old shell shines like an emerald tonight!
You guide this lost little hermit crab to the perfect trade route,
making even the weight of this backpack feel light as down…!
[A line added in rough handwriting]
Tsk, tsk! Instead of scribbling nonsense, go retie your backpack straps!
My back's all bent out of shape from picking up the gold coins you dropped yesterday!
[A note folded neatly at the top corner]
May Polaris's guidance be with us always.
P.S. But don't walk around staring at the sky for too long.
Trip over a rock 'cause you weren't watching your step, and a cracked shell is the least of your worries—you'll spill all your gold.
[A note proudly pinned at the very top of the board]
One. When lost, fold your claws together and bow reverently toward Polaris.
Two. When you turn a big profit on a trade, shake your backpack three times toward Polaris.
Three. Before doing either of the above, always check that your backpack straps are secure first. (VERY important)
This is a land of crevices, where only the old shells blessed by starlight may dwell.
To the unfamiliar outsider who knows not the weight upon our backs,
Please, quietly turn your steps back toward wherever your path was leading.

lines.speaker: SpiderWarrior
lines.text: Ah, that's understandable. No worries.

lines.speaker: SpiderWarrior
lines.text: Refusing has cost you your life.

Accept.
Decline.
Thank you. I'll follow you.
Thx

So this is... The Rapids.
I heard those [Lucid Sect] scum are hiding here.
I will hunt down every last one of you vermin.
Waah
Astrid, I will find you no matter what...

lines.text: Hello. I am a hero.
